test_objective: Check that you can update the types on an entity

test_cases.name: 011_06_01 Append type to an entity
test_cases.doc: Check that type is appended if it is not yet in the target entity
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/'
        method set to 'GET'
        Request Retrieve Entity by Id and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/json' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld'
}
